name: Tian Lun Gas Holdings Limited
summary: Tian Lun Gas Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides gas pipeline construction and infrastructure laying and installation in China. It operates through four segments: Sales of Natural Gas in Cylinders, Sales of Natural Gas in Bulk, Engineering Construction Services, and Other. The company engages in the transportation, distribution, and sale of natural gas and compressed natural gas, as well as production and sale of liquified natural gas in bulk and cylinders.
